subject: preventing timeout externally of shiny server

messages.author: 71cdc2d1ceb324f4
messages.subject: preventing timeout externally of shiny server
parts:
Hi so I found shiny-server a bit confusing and can not get 'shinyapps.io' to recognise some of the unregistered packages that I'm using so on the advice of a professor of mine, I am initialising my shiny website as follows:

In a file called '0start_server.com': 
module load R/3.1
R --vanilla --no-save < 0shine.R > 0log.out 2>&1

And this initiates '0shine.R':
library(shiny)
runApp(port=2016, launch.browser = FALSE,  host = getOption("shiny.host", "0.0.0.0"))

My problem is that I have a large file that I need to be able to upload to the site and process (up to 20 mins). And naturally shiny times out every time that I try to process the file when the page has been deployed to the web. The analysis keeps running in the background even after the page has timed out....

As per the following post: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/timeout/shiny-discuss/tUcEMk1Av8Y/1nGtu71yhnwJ

I would be able to use a config file in conjunction with shiny server or adjust the waiting time in shinyapps.io but as I am deploying my website unconventionally, I am hoping there is a way to make sure the page waits until the desired graphs are renderable...
Any tips?
